note: Curated `related:` links between operations. Merged with the deterministic same-intent-tool seed by scripts/skills/build-index.mjs (see lib/graph.mjs mergeRelated). Directed: {from, to} adds `to` to the `related:` list of `from`'s op file, so author both directions when the relationship is useful both ways. Ids are validated by scripts/skills/lint.mjs (rule curated-link); duplicate pairs are rejected there too. Output order is sorted by the generator, so this file's order is not significant. Hand-edit this file only - never skills/ops/*.md or skills/moc/*.md. Every reason must describe something the target's handler or description actually does - a plausible-looking reason is what the J8 link review rejected.
